title: Signup to Dodo nbn, Activate in 30 Days & Stay 60 Days for $100 Cashback (New Dodo Customers) @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Signup to Dodo nbn, Activate in 30 Days & Stay 60 Days for $100 Cashback (New Dodo Customers) @ TopCashback AU

[dangerdanger] I'm looking to move from Exetel to Dodo. Anyone have good / bad experiences with Dodo?
[Herbs] Moved to Dodo 500/50 about 5 months ago. It's been fine, no issues and speed is as advertised.
[PandaExpress] I started getting lots of dropouts after opting out of CGNAT. Enough that I switched elsewhere.
[nospirit] That would turn me away from Dodo, anyone else can confirm/deny this? Thanks
[FLICKIT] With Dodo, opted out of CGNAT, no issues…
[xfelix] Reason to exit Exetel? It’s my candidate when Leaptel one year expires.
[Churna] just follow the cashbacks and deal my friend.
[alz] Signed up couple days ago $100 tracked. Activated in a couple minutes everything went smoothy
[Averell] In the context of NBN, what is the difference between sign-up and activate? Thanks
[alz] Submit order, couple minutes it was active, didn't even need to restart router and also my previous provider was cancelled automatically.
[jaydee4] On Dodo 500/50. I get 430Mbps, sometimes lower and this is during offpeak hours. No dropouts. I also can't access Japanese websites for some reason.
Previously with Spintel 500/50 and I was getting 520 down, 45 up.
[mallard19] Not entirely happy with Dodo. Frequent speed issues in the afternoon / evening.
[Jolakot] Dodo has been pretty awful, looking to move as soon as we can, just due to frequent drop-outs and slow downs, which weren't an issue on Leaptel
[team teri] With other providers everything just worked out of the box, with Dodo I had to make a few changes in my router to get everything working.
Their support was ok. Very quick to talk to a real person. And at least they didn't hang up on me when I refused to factory reset my router - their default suggestion for everything, it would seem.
Turned out that the way they set up the Dynamic IP required a connection using username and password that I had never been given.
Getting IPV6 to work with them wasn't straightforward either, but Gemini was useful.
[Think] @Twix:
Dynamic IP required a connection using username and password
Above is confusing for IPoE.
[CVonC] They actually use both. IPoE by default but you can change to PPPoE if you want on request.
[Asti] I had the same thing. I'm a constant churner and they have been the most annoying so far.
[scoaus] Dodo hasn't been great, (second time trying them and will be the last). Making the jump to Tangerine, due to frequent drop-outs and slow downs during peak, which wasn't an issue on Superloop.
[TerryTightwad] So would you say its not worth it even to save money? Seems like it.
[Kawaii] Yeah same. Amaysim killed me. Having so much latency issues after switching
Not even worth $20/month of their 500m NBN
[Chhaava] Me too, same reason. I'm currently with 1st energy, paying $52 for 500/50
[HeyJes] Agreed. They initially blocked my email domain causing major trouble to me…
[dosada] How much do you need to hate someone to recommend dodo to them?
[WoolyWonka] I've had good experience with dodo. Quick service, no interpretations, and reasonable offers. However, offers are only to new customers. Existing customers pay premium price
[onon0402] Poor customer service experience. My connection was never set up properly, and despite reporting the issue, no technician was sent to check it. I paid for the first month but received no usable service. Would not recommend.
[TEER3X] Worked fine for me last deal, cashback approved.
Switched to 1st energy $52/m and also working great.
[FLICKIT] Be mindful you don't get the cashback for 6 months..
[TerryTightwad] That doesn’t matter though, as-long as you get it.
[JustWantToSave] I cycle through offers every 2-3 months anyway.
So I'm getting payouts every 2-3 months after a certain point.
[DealBreaker85] My cash back is approved from a similar dodo deal from June. I will get paid in December, but if I switch now to another provider, can they cancel my cash back? Thanks!
[JustWantToSave] No.
You can switch any time after the required time period.
In this case, 60 days.
It's just that it takes topcashback those 6 months to get paid by dodo and then pay you.
[Samson2020] Last time I had to contact Dodo support they answered the phone within 30 seconds and resolved the issue within 5 minutes. The last time I contacted AussieBB support, I was on hold for over an hour had to hang up drive to where I could get 4g signal and use thier app to resolve the issue. both within the last 3 months..
[TerryTightwad] Yes, I noticed Aussiebroadband was not the best support, But its been perfect service not needed to contact them.
[BewareOfThe Dog] ice been with ABB for 3 years now. I've never called them. Having a decent Deco Router helps.
[amit2689] Isn't Finder + Optus 500 at $69 with $250 gift card better option?
[TerryTightwad] Didnt realise that deal was still on, seems quite good then if they really do payout.
[BewareOfThe Dog] definitly not greatest of all time. dodo make tpg look good.
[hawkeye93] Takes ages to withdraw the cashback. Mine from June was already approved/confirmed, but still not withdrawable, looks like won’t be until December. This sucks.
[DealBreaker85] Same for me and wondering if switching to another provider will void the cash back or not.
[Maxxjet] It's a business as its name suggests… perosnal experince with them 10 years ago and 2 months ago were same, terrible… YMMV
[burns13] Had a dispute over continued bill cycle AFTER I disconnected from their service. Phillipines call centre bunch of thieves could not resolve a basic issue on their end. Dodo never again
[onceupon8] Some providers like Tangerine (and it sounds like Dodo) don't stop billing you after you port away. You need to actually cancel your service with them.
[TEER3X] I just ported away from dodo nbn and didn't have to cancel.
Just checked it now to make sure and it says service cancelled.
Fairly sure I had that issue with Tangerine though but they eventually refunded me.
[burns13] Dodo "offered" me 50% off. After multiple attempts.
I simply didn't pay it.
[burns13] I actually chatted with a dodo tech, requesting some ID number AussieBB needed. I clearly explained I was cancelling Dodo and going with another service. Dodo (true to their name) gave me the number and didn't cancel my service.
I had proof of a conversation with a tech but no transcript. This still wasn't enough for them. Anti consumer behaviour
[lawyerz] The avc id number is online and in the app. The cancellation is automatic, as I just cancelled dodo and went to belong NBN.
[burns13] @lawyerz: Ull ID number was requested. 4 years ago
[FLICKIT] You can cancel easily online through My-Dodo, they're one of the very few that let you cancel without having to call them and jump through hoops…
[lawyerz] I'm still waiting for the $120 cashback from the last dodo deal…
